assessed_protocol.permitted_inference: a complete-case comparison of bounded Stage-A detector-visible escape yield only when every censor-status proportion is exactly balanced between the compared frozen cohorts
assessed_protocol.primary_estimand: certified Stage-A detector yield per scheduled fibre (intention to search)
assessed_protocol.primary_event: at least one exactly certified Stage-A quotient direction

available_calibration.interpretation: The sealed controls establish bounded-search sensitivity and class-set enrichment, but they all have displayed jump 12 and therefore cannot identify score-versus-jump magnitude or upper-tail calibration.

censoring_policy.balance_rule: each distinct censored Stage-A status must have exactly the same scheduled-row proportion in both compared arms
censoring_policy.failure_action: set risk difference, risk ratio, odds ratio, and Fisher exact p to null and authorize no prospective cohort conclusion
censoring_policy.observed_events_on_censored_rows: retain as exact descriptive lower-bound events only; do not place the row in an inferential event-rate denominator

forbidden: rank or rank-jump evidence without exact returned points
legacy_half_lattice_depth.permitted: a fixed-presentation CVP-derived score for ordering birational point-search charts

forbidden: a complete set of locally soluble coverings
a reason to exclude unsearched chart labels
old_deep_43.permitted: a historically calibrated list of 43 chart labels for one exact generic basis and height form

forbidden: an invariant of the quotient group
Selmer filtration or residual Selmer dimension
evidence that higher-weight charts contain no points
quotient_hamming_weight.permitted: an enumeration order in one explicitly recorded quotient-coordinate basis

ordering_invalidation.empirical_effectiveness_transfer: none: any efficiency or enrichment claim must be revalidated on blinded controls for the changed presentation
invalidating_changes: finite-index enlargement or saturation of the discovered subgroup
adding, deleting, reordering, negating, or otherwise changing a basis generator
changing the height Gram used for representative selection
changing the quotient-coordinate basis or complement
changing the chart universe or its coordinate labels
ordering_invalidation.required_action: discard the cached ordering; recompute chart identities, shortest representatives, scores, and the complete intended order; bind the result to the new lattice-state fingerprint before another search

chart_order_policy.positive_evidence_rule: only an exactly mapped rational point followed by the separately required group-law and independence checks can change a rank lower bound

claim_boundary: Protocol v3 remains an immutable bounded-search record, but its scheduled-denominator contrast is not authorized for inference.
No v3 binary success, effect size, or p-value can authorize a rank-32 candidate.
No prospective cohort effect is estimable unless censoring is exactly balanced by failure status between its arms.
The available controls do not validate magnitude tracking or extreme-tail incidence.
Legacy depth, old-deep-43, and quotient-Hamming fields order birational search charts only; they encode no covering, Selmer, or rank structure.
A chart miss cannot prove rational-point absence, local insolubility, Selmer structure, Mordell--Weil saturation, or a rank upper bound.
A score g exactly certifies rank at least 17+g on that fibre, but g<15 cannot promote it on the hope of enough unseen directions; a bounded miss is not a rank upper bound.

detector_score.definition_for_any_successor: exact finite-reduction-certified Stage-A quotient gain beyond specialized MW17 per scheduled fibre

legacy_field_interpretation.depth_fields: retained only as fixed-presentation CVP chart-priority scores; they are not arithmetic depths or filtrations
legacy_field_interpretation.old_deep_43: a calibrated search-order list for its recorded generic basis, not a basis-invariant arithmetic subset
legacy_field_interpretation.quotient_hamming_weight: an enumeration order in one recorded quotient basis, not a Selmer or Mordell--Weil filtration

promotion_requirements.balanced_censoring: Before reporting any prospective cohort contrast, pass the exact censor-status balance rule and use only completed Stage-A rows in the event-rate denominator.
promotion_requirements.candidate_rule: Freeze a score threshold justified by those magnitude and tail checks. Neither one detected direction nor a significant binary cohort contrast may promote a fibre.
promotion_requirements.existing_arithmetic_gate: Any expensive rank-32 follow-up still requires the separately declared completed residual 2-Selmer quotient gate on the same minimal curve.
promotion_requirements.independent_magnitude_validation: Freeze the score and an outcome-independent validation panel spanning multiple exact displayed-quotient or certified rank-jump strata; predeclare and pass a directional association rule with uncertainty.
promotion_requirements.state_bound_chart_ordering: After every independent-point addition, finite-index enlargement, generator or basis change, height-form change, or quotient-basis change, discard the old order. Recompute chart identities, shortest representatives, scores, and the intended order, then bind them to the new lattice-state fingerprint before searching. Efficiency or enrichment calibration does not transfer to the changed state.
promotion_requirements.tail_validation: Before opening outcomes, define the upper-tail rank/jump threshold and minimum effect, then show that the score enriches that tail rather than only the event jump>=1.

rank_32_target.direct_certificate_rule: Fifteen exactly certified independent directions beyond specialized MW17 directly prove rank at least 32; that is a lower-bound certificate, not score-based candidate promotion.
